summary: E6b meets acceptance line 2. On all four Pulsar volleys, every member's event shows on a note, plates plus acting captains peak at 4, and both tenders dock together (tenders() shows 2 docking at once). One Minor: the e2e check of named people (≥ people) also counts other maneuvers' crews in the fused beat. One Nit: the stills are too far out to show the docking, and their file names count turns from 1. solar.spec:352 passed. solar-dense:295 ('at most four labels') flaked once at 5 labels. It predates E6b: the base cc89afb shows the same overflow at x ≈ 31.2 s in meridian Convoy (no volleys there) in 2 of 4 runs.
